one_trait_can_get_nomad_trigger = {
	has_mpo_dlc_trigger = yes
}

one_trait_can_get_administrative_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = {
				name = city_construction_is_temple_citadel
				name = city_construction_is_castle
			}
		}
		always = no
	}
}

one_trait_can_get_japan_administrative_trigger = {
	has_tgp_dlc_trigger = yes
	top_liege = { 
		OR = {
			government_is_japanese_trigger = yes
			has_character_flag = tgp_japan_restore_japanese_government_flag
		}
	}
}

one_trait_can_get_japan_feudal_trigger = {
	tgp_can_become_japanese_feudal_trigger = yes
}

one_trait_can_get_mandala_trigger = {
	has_tgp_dlc_trigger = yes
	OR = {
		liege ?= { has_government = mandala_government }
		is_independent_ruler = yes
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = {
				name = city_construction_is_temple_citadel
				name = city_construction_is_castle
			}
		}
		capital_province = { has_holding_type = temple_citadel_holding }
	}
}
